acceptance_criteria: AC-01: project.yaml has a verifiable schema, example instance, naming decision, and explicit version-evolution rules.

AC-02: project.yaml expresses stable project and task-space identities, one selected adapter, issuance policy, WorkItem bindings, one system of record, revision/conflict semantics, and the minimum status map without credentials or personal connection data.

AC-03: a provider-neutral TaskSource/TaskSink contract supports resolve, fetch, changes, create, update, transition, and comment; every write requires expected_revision and conflicts force a re-read and stop.
AC-04: one local SQLite adapter completes initialize -> create -> resolve/fetch -> update/transition/comment -> changes as a runnable end-to-end loop.
AC-05: automated checks cover initialization, atomic unique issuance, idempotent or duplicate binding behavior, revision conflicts, reads, changes, and the minimum status flow.
AC-06: implementation aligns with the existing WorkItem, TaskSource/TaskSink, and governance handoff contract without adding an owner or state slice.
AC-07: registry.json and skills/engineering continue to expose exactly the existing five public engineering Skills.
AC-08: the candidate records parallel assignments, disjoint write scopes, integration order, exact Git refs, and independent QA evidence.
AC-09: repository, project-schema, documentation-link, and adapter tests pass at the frozen aggregate head.
AC-10: delivery stops at a clean local PIC aggregate candidate commit; no push, publication, deployment, main merge, history rewrite, branch deletion, or worktree deletion occurs.

goal-r1.summary: Establish a project-scoped task-system binding and one reliable local adapter that closes the smallest provider-neutral WorkItem loop.

architecture-r1.summary: Keep exactly five public engineering Skills; place schemas, validation, documentation, and the isolated adapter package outside the public Skill registry.
decisions: Normalize the intake typo project.ymal to project.yaml and record the canonical name.
Choose Python standard-library SQLite over a file store because transactions, uniqueness constraints, and compare-and-swap updates provide the requested integrity with fewer custom failure paths.
Use one project-local SQLite database as task state; project.yaml is configuration and adapter binding, never Session or Agent state.
Defer GitHub Issues until a demonstrated cross-machine or hosted-review need; Jira is out of scope for the first delivery.
Do not add governance owners, contract slices, public Skills, aliases, or registry entries.

closure_decision.loop: project maintainer -> initialize project binding -> create and mutate one WorkItem -> observe stable id and revisioned history -> decide whether another provider is justified
closure_decision.success_signal: the frozen candidate passes one end-to-end local adapter test plus schema and governance validation
closure_decision.recommended_path: project.yaml + provider-neutral contract + one SQLite adapter
default_now: SQLite from the Python standard library
JSON-schema validation with a dependency-free project validator
defer_until: GitHub Issues adapter until remote collaboration or hosted review is required
additional status vocabulary until a project profile demonstrates it
reject: a duplicate project or agent state machine
closure_decision.known_ceiling: The local database is a single project-space authority and is not a distributed multi-writer service.
closure_decision.replacement_seam: The provider-neutral TaskSource/TaskSink boundary and explicit project.yaml adapter binding permit an authorized adapter migration.

tasks-r1.acyclic_evidence: Each edge points from a higher-numbered task to a lower-numbered dependency; D1 and D2 are independent after D0.

integration_evidence: Contributor merge bases both equal 60bebbe1eb5d79c5b887017c41b59ea41d47a108 and their write scopes are disjoint

impact_record.reason: Record the exact implementation candidate and QA assignment in the repository system of record after independent QA rejected missing in-tree freeze evidence.

closure_impact_record.reason: Record independent QA acceptance and close the local candidate gate.

remote_sync_decision.reason: After local candidate closure, the user explicitly requested that the aggregate branch be pushed to origin and opened as a GitHub pull request for hosted review and CI.

impact_record.reason: The new revision authorizes remote review only; it does not alter the accepted implementation candidate or its gates.

naming_decision.reason: Use the conventional YAML extension and treat the original spelling as a noncanonical intake typo; no alias or compatibility file will be added.
